name: New Horizons Food Solutions
old_description: New Horizons Food Solutions (NHFS) is a contract food manufacturing and food ingredient manufacturer partner willing to lean in, adapt, and get it right. From dry and ready-to-use liquid ingredient blending and custom packaging to full-scale food production, we help bring great-tasting products to market with consistency, flexibility, and care.
about:
New Horizons Food Solutions operates from Columbus, Ohio, as a minority-owned, women-led business built on a multi-generational family legacy in food manufacturing. The company traces its roots to the New Horizons Baking Company, which supplies large-scale baking solutions for a major quick-service restaurant brand, and the Genesis Baking Company, known for English muffins and soft rolls for iconic brands. While a founding year is not publicly disclosed, the organization has grown into a managed food solutions partner that integrates formulation, blending, packaging, and logistics under one roof.

NHFS provides contract food manufacturing and ingredient production, specializing in custom dry blends — such as seasoning systems, bakery blends, and multi-stage nutritional premixes — and ready-to-use liquid formulations including sauces, marinades, soups, dips, and concentrates. The facility operates at commercial scale with GFSI AA-graded, SQF-certified processes, supporting high-volume, long-running programs for foodservice, manufacturing, and retail channels. In-house capabilities span R&D and culinary development, specialty packaging tailored to throughput needs, and supply chain coordination backed by a dedicated transportation company, Metraco.

The company serves quick-service and fast-casual restaurant chains, food manufacturers and co-manufacturers, better-for-you and high-protein brands, nutrition and fortification producers, food aid and humanitarian organizations, and retail and ecommerce brands. Customers include a national baked goods partner, an iconic national QSR brand, and a global food aid organization, all of whom rely on NHFS for consistent flavor, reduced prep variability, and scalable production that protects proprietary formulas.

NHFS differentiates itself through a white-label model that safeguards customer intellectual property, an integrated team of food scientists and culinarians who collaborate from concept through commercialization, and an agile, responsive partnership structure that emphasizes direct communication and ownership of complex formulation challenges. The minority-owned, women-led leadership frames this approach as a continuation of a family legacy grounded in integrity and accountability.
